about_the_game:
🎩 BOXKING 👑 - Bounce the box! Become the king!

Simple but 100% addictive! 🚀 One click of the mouse and the box will bounce and avoid obstacles and fly to the target point~! 🎯 But don't let your guard down!

🎮 How to play

✅ Click the mouse to bounce the box!✅ Avoid obstacles such as solid walls, wooden boxes, flames, and skulls! 💀🔥✅ When you reach the target point, GO to the next level! 🚀

💰 Coin & Ruby System

💎 Collect coins during the game to upgrade your ability to get more coins and rubies!💎 Collect coins and rubies to buy colorful box skins and play more stylishly! 🎨✨

🔥 Why should you play BOXKING?

✔️ Simple but fun to play!✔️ Increasingly difficult levels stimulate your desire for challenge!✔️ Cute box customization to show off your own personality! 🎭

Are you ready? Bounce the boxes, avoid obstacles, collect coins, and become the king! 👑

📦 BOXKING – Challenge now! 🏆
